dedupe_keys.name: polnilnice za polnjenje e vozil z navedenim seznamom lokacij

description: Polnilnice za polnjenje e-vozil z navedenim seznamom lokacij is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KAMNIK. In 2018-2020, the Municipality of Kamnik set up 6 AC charging stations for charging electric vehicles at the Kamnik Culture Centre, at the Post Office at Duplica, at the Snovik Spa, at the Franciscan Square, at the Dr. Julija Polca Kamnik Health Centre and at the P+R Graben. Coverage: OBČINA KAMNIK. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for e-vehicles with a list of locations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KAMNIK. Its keywords include polnilnice za e-vozila, električna vozila. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
